===Etymology 1===
{{etymon|en|id=act of forming|:inh|enm:making<ety:inh<ang:macung>>|tree=1}}
From {{inh|en|enm|making}}, from {{inh|en|ang|macung||making}}, equivalent to {{suffix|en|make|ing}}. Cognate with dated {{cog|nl|making||making}}, {{cog|goh|machunga}}.

====Noun====
{{en-noun|~}}

# The act of forming, causing, or constituting; [[workmanship]]; [[construction]].
#: {{ux|en|during the '''making''' of the movie}}
# Process of [[growth]] or [[development]].
#: {{ux|en|As a child, he didn’t seem like a genius [[in the making|in the '''making''']].}}
# Something that causes somebody's success or progress
#: {{ux|en|a book that was the '''making''' of his career}}
